laws.rule: Óbidos charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 1 per guest per night (about A$1.59, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) for guests 13 and over, up to 5 nights. Nazaré has charged EUR 1 per guest per night for guests 12 and over, up to 5 nights, since 1 September 2026.

layers.authority: ICNF (Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas), BerlengasPass
layers.process: Landing on the Berlenga island (Reserva Natural das Berlengas, off Peniche) needs a personal, non-transferable BerlengasPass access title, obtained by registering at berlengaspass.icnf.pt. It is compulsory for every visitor, children under 6 included. Staying on the island without a valid title is an administrative offence. The land area is capped at 550 people at once (Portaria 355/2019). The access fee in ICNF's 2022 FAQ is EUR 3 per person per day (about A$4.77 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293); visitors aged 7 to 17 and over 65 pay half, under 7s pay nothing, and residents of the Peniche municipality are exempt. An account can issue up to 6 titles. Cancel up to 48 hours before; the fee is refunded only if ICNF cancels access (for example bad weather). The fee is set by Portaria 19/2022 and updated yearly, so the 2026 amount is not confirmed here.

zone-requirements.note: Berlengas FAQ read as dated 31 May 2022; confirm the current fee on berlengaspass.icnf.pt.
